verdict.rationale: vLLM ships a CLI, but the documented subcommands only start the OpenAI-compatible server, run benchmarks, and print throughput stats. Nothing in the evidence shows commands to search, download, list, or manage models. Hugging Face integration covers loading models for serving, not CLI model management, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, download, and manage models from a command-line interface
